items.source: Auto-configuration for AI Retry. Provides beans for retry template and response error handling. Handles transient and non-transient exceptions based on HTTP status codes.
items.translation: AI 重试的自动配置。提供用于重试模板和响应错误处理的 Bean。根据 HTTP 状态码处理瞬态和非瞬态异常。

items.source: Christian Tzolov, SriVarshan P, Seunggyu Lee
